parse_notes: site-table label 'O' resolves to element O (QE's documented label rule); its declared mass 15.999 u is promoted to atoms.masses.
site-table label 'H' resolves to element H (QE's documented label rule); its declared mass 1.008 u is promoted to atoms.masses.
site-table label 'H' resolves to element H (QE's documented label rule); its declared mass 1.008 u is promoted to atoms.masses.
The declared atomic-species table (label → valence, mass, pseudopotential) rides verbatim in user_metadata.custom_global['qe_pw_out:atomic_species'] — nothing declared is dropped (P1).
Initial cell read from the 'crystal axes' block in units of alat and converted to Å (alat = 9.448630664428 bohr × 0.52917720859 = 4.999999999999885 Å).
Initial positions read from the site table (site n. atom …), which declares its unit: ATOMIC_POSITIONS {bohr}: positions converted Bohr → Å (× 0.52917720859, QE's CODATA bohr radius).
pbc set to (true,true,true): a pw.x input carries no PBC declaration and QE is always fully periodic (format-defined, not assumed).
electronic.total_energy read from the '!    total energy' line in Rydberg and converted to eV (× 13.605693122994, QE's RYTOEV — Modules/constants.f90).

dynamics.forces read from the 'Forces acting on atoms' block in Ry/bohr and converted to eV/Å (× RYTOEV / bohr_radius_angs = × 25.71103385054424). Forces are the forces acting on the atoms (-dE/dr), the same convention as VASP's TOTAL-FORCE column, so no sign flip.
simulation.source_code set to the PWSCF program banner (verbatim).
Each ionic step's own CELL_PARAMETERS card (when present) supplies that step's cell at its declared unit; a step without one reuses the initial cell (correct for fixed-cell runs).
Each ionic step's own ATOMIC_POSITIONS card (when present) supplies that step's positions at its declared unit; a step without one reuses the initial configuration.

electronic.stress mapped from the 'total   stress' 3×3 tensor in Ry/bohr³: QE prints compression-positive (the ASE reference reader confirms 'sign convention is opposite'), so the tensor is sign-flipped to canonical tension-positive and converted × 91.8157694288102 eV/Å³ per Ry/bohr³. The per-row kbar column is cross-checked against the Ry/bohr³ value (× 147105.07919960306 kBar per Ry/bohr³) and the agreement recorded. A step without a stress block leaves electronic.stress None (P3 — never a defaulted zero tensor).

Declared atomic-species masses promote to atoms.masses (present-with-value, P3); the valence and pseudopotential columns of the declared species table are carried verbatim in user_metadata.custom_global['qe_pw_out:atomic_species'] (label → [valence, mass, pseudopotential]).
